verdict.rationale: Zapier documents an official SDK (@zapier/zapier-sdk via npm) with quickstart and CLI usage for authenticating and executing actions across 9,000+ apps, plus a Platform CLI for building integrations, giving AI-native developers concrete SDK/CLI surfaces to build against. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the SDK's reliability and completeness, and a public OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s).
